Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with Concert Director, remote instrument and ARM controls, and scheduled playback. Includes copyable relay diagnostics, Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars. Hosted STARTs require all performers to confirm they are armed; failed or missing confirmations cancel the downbeat for the whole band. Hosted ensembles now report real note-dispatch timing, RTT and clock stability; followers can fine-tune a local timing offset for duets.
Changelog: Relay duet timing diagnostics: separate connection uptime and START acknowledgement latency from measured MIDI note scheduling; report follower and conductor first/mean/worst callback delays, RTT and clock offset spread; adjustable follower trim (-250..+250ms). Preserves 0.46.6 encoder fix and all-Bard START confirmation.
